facts.text: 오스트레일리아는 1924년 연방 선거에 도입

facts.quote: If no satisfactory reason is provided (for example, illness or religious prohibition), a fine of up to $170 is imposed

facts.quote: The 1925 federal election was the first to be conducted under compulsory voting, which saw the turnout rise to 91.4%.

facts.quote: Belgium has the oldest extant compulsory voting system which was introduced in 1893 for men, and in 1948 for women.

extra.text: 벨기에 · 그리스 · 룩셈부르크 · 멕시코 · 튀르키예는 법으로는 의무지만 실제로 처벌하지 않음

facts.text: 신경계가 특정 자극에 특히 민감한 성숙 단계
facts.quote: a critical period is a maturational stage in the lifespan of an organism during which the nervous system is especially sensitive to certain environmental stimuli.

facts.text: 이 시기를 넘기면 언어 습득이 훨씬 어렵고 덜 성공적이라는 가설
facts.quote: The critical period hypothesis (CPH) states that the first few years of life constitute the time during which language develops readily and after which (sometime between age 5 and puberty) language acquisition is much more difficult and ultimately less successful.

facts.text: 로렌츠의 회색기러기 각인 연구가 유명
facts.quote: Konrad Lorenz is well known for his classic studies of filial imprinting in graylag geese.

facts.text: 언어의 결정적 시기 가설은 1959년 펜필드 · 로버츠가 처음 내고 1967년 레너버그가 널리 알림
facts.quote: The hypothesis that language is acquired during a critical period was first proposed by neurologists Wilder Penfield and Lamar Roberts in 1959 and popularized by linguist Eric Lenneberg in 1967.

facts.text: 레너버그는 두 살부터 사춘기 무렵까지로 봄
언어 습득은 대뇌 편재화가 끝나는 사춘기 무렵 전에 이뤄져야 한다는 가설
facts.quote: The critical period hypothesis holds that first language acquisition must occur before cerebral lateralization completes, at about the age of puberty.

extra.text: 결정적 시기를 지나 말을 배우지 못한 사례로 아베롱의 빅토르와 지니가 가장 유명
extra.quote: The two most famous cases of children who failed to acquire language after the critical period are the feral children Victor of Aveyron and Genie.

items.note: 해설의 '레너버그가 두 살부터'는 확인 못 함 — 사춘기 끝 · 1967 대중화까지만. 가설을 처음 낸 사람은 펜필드 · 로버츠(1959).

facts.quote: was a rectangular mass military formation, usually composed entirely of heavy infantry armed with spears, pikes, sarissas, or similar polearms tightly packed together.

facts.quote: while a casino may lose money in a single spin of the roulette wheel, its earnings will tend towards a predictable percentage over a large number of spins.

facts.text: 보험에도 쓰임
facts.quote: Today, the law of large numbers is used in many fields including statistics, probability theory, economics, and insurance.

extra.text: 16세기 이탈리아 수학자 카르다노가 증명 없이 '시행이 많을수록 경험 통계가 정확해진다'고 적음
extra.quote: The Italian mathematician Gerolamo Cardano (1501–1576) stated without proof that the accuracies of empirical statistics tend to improve with the number of trials.

extra.text: 적은 횟수가 기대값에 맞거나 연속된 결과가 곧 '균형'을 맞춘다는 원리는 없음(도박사의 오류)
extra.quote: There is no principle that a small number of observations will coincide with the expected value or that a streak of one value will immediately be "balanced" by the others

items.note: e2 는 '도박사의 오류'가 다른 문항 정답이면 쓰지 않는다.

facts.text: 백합은 줄기 · 잎 · 꽃 · 꽃가루 · 꽃병 물까지 고양이에게 독
facts.quote: The entire lily plant is toxic: the stem, leaves, flowers, pollen, and even the water in a vase.

facts.text: 조금만 먹거나 털에 묻은 꽃가루를 핥아도 3일 안에 치명적인 신부전
facts.quote: Eating just a small amount of a leaf or flower petal, licking a few pollen grains off its fur while grooming, or drinking the water from the vase can cause your cat to develop fatal kidney failure in less than 3 days.

facts.text: 콩팥 세뇨관을 손상시켜 급성 신부전
facts.quote: it involves damage to the renal tubular epithelium (composing the substance of the kidney and secreting, collecting, and conducting urine), which can cause acute kidney failure.

facts.text: 나팔 모양 큰 꽃 · 알뿌리 꽃
수태고지 그림에 자주 나옴(성모와 연결된 마돈나 릴리)
facts.quote: Medieval and Renaissance depictions of the Virgin Mary, especially at the Annunciation, often show her with these flowers.

facts.text: 개는 신부전이 생기지 않음(가벼운 배탈 정도)
facts.quote: Dogs that eat lilies may have minor stomach upset but they don’t develop kidney failure.

extra.text: 신장 손상 증상은 먹은 뒤 12~24시간에 시작되고 치료하지 않으면 24~72시간 안에 신부전으로 죽을 수 있음
extra.quote: Kidney failure occurs within 24 to 72 hours, leading to death if the cat isn’t treated.
